title: Mimicked Mouse Movement Neural Network
summary: Scripts for generating human-like mouse-movement traces from recorded Akamai `mact` telemetry, given a start and an end position. SDV's sequential and tabular synthesizers are run directly as the project's generators, with `sdv==0.6.1` pinned.
